statements.status_notes: Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66053

CVE-2026-43870 covers path traversal, HTTP response splitting, origin validation, and resource consumption bugs in the Apache Thrift Node.js web_server.js sample server. The Debian thrift package does not install Node.js components; only C++ runtime libraries appear in the SBOM.

CVE-2026-43869 is missing TLS hostname verification in Apache Thrift Java client transports (TSSLTransportFactory.java and TNonblockingSSLSocket.java). The Debian thrift binary packages contain C++ shared libraries only; Java thrift client classes are not installed.
CVE-2026-43868 is excessive memory allocation in the Apache Thrift Rust implementation. The Debian thrift package provides C++ libraries only; no Rust thrift runtime is built or shipped.

CVE-2026-41636 is uncontrolled recursion in the Apache Thrift Node.js bindings. The Debian thrift package does not build or ship Node.js artifacts; only C++ runtime libraries are present in the image SBOM.

CVE-2026-41605 is an integer overflow in the Apache Thrift Swift Compact Protocol implementation. The Debian thrift binary packages ship only C++ shared libraries; Swift language bindings are not built or installed.

CVE-2026-41604 is an out-of-bounds read in the Apache Thrift Swift bindings (Swift Range crash in skip()). The Debian thrift source package builds only C++ runtime libraries (libthrift, libthriftnb, libthriftz, libthriftqt5); Swift bindings are not built or shipped. Debian security tracking marks the fix experimental with a note that Swift bindings are not built in the Debian package.

CVE-2026-43868 is excessive memory allocation in the Apache Thrift Rust implementation. Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 builds with --without-rust and does not ship Rust bindings.
CVE-2026-41636 is uncontrolled recursion in the Apache Thrift Node.js bindings. Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 ships C++, Python, PHP, Perl, and Go bindings but does not build or ship Node.js artifacts.

CVE-2026-41605 is an integer overflow in the Apache Thrift Swift Compact Protocol implementation. Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 ships C++, Python, PHP, Perl, and Go bindings but does not build or ship Swift language bindings.

CVE-2026-41604 is an out-of-bounds read in the Apache Thrift Swift bindings (Swift Range crash in skip()). Debian thrift 0.19.0-4 ships C++, Python, PHP, Perl, and Go bindings but does not build or ship Swift bindings. Debian security tracking marks the fix experimental with a note that Swift bindings are not built in the Debian package.
